raw_response:
I am old now, so I do not want to gamble too much. Five mu is not much land, and there are only two people in my house, so I have to keep the work and the cash steady. Cotton is still my main crop because I know it well, but I will keep some land in wheat and maize together. That way, if cotton price is no good or pests are bad, I still have grain. I do mostly what worked before. If I change, it is only a little. Fertilizer is not cheap, water from the well also costs money, so I will not push too hard, but I also do not want the crop to look weak. I watch my own field and also what the neighbors do. For cotton, I will keep it on 3 mu. For the other 2 mu, I will do the usual wheat-maize rotation on the same land. Wheat needs a few waterings, maize I will see by rain, and cotton I will irrigate when it is dry at the key time.
